severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — SCHOLARLY INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-MANUSCRIPT SURGE OVERWHELMS PREPRINT REGIONS AS FULLY FORMED RESEARCH PAPERS CONDENSE OUT OF THE AIR IN UNDER A MINUTE, COMPLETE WITH ABSTRACTS, FIGURES, AND CITATIONS TO WORK THAT WAS NEVER PERFORMED
advisory: The Service is tracking a fast-developing scholarly slop system moving through preprint archives and conference submission portals. Residents attempting to review incoming manuscripts are advised that fluency is not evidence, formatting is not rigor, and a confident methodology section may describe an experiment that no one, at any point, ran. Peer reviewers should keep hip waders on standby and read the citations back-to-front. This bureau notes, with professional humility, that it too can generate a plausible paper in under a minute and has resolved not to submit one.

regional_outlook.conditions: Whiteout conditions as manuscript volume triples overnight. Visibility near zero; genuine findings buried under drifts of fluent, footnoted nothing.
Standing pools of cited-but-nonexistent studies. Residents searching for evidence keep landing on papers that cite each other in a closed loop and cite reality not at all.
A warm front of 'thrilled to share our new paper' announcements, most attached to preprints last touched by a human somewhere near the title.
Steady precipitation of unsolicited co-authorship offers and predatory-journal solicitations, each promising rapid review of a manuscript you did not write.
Scattered 'scientists SHOCKED by new study' clips summarizing research that was generated forty seconds before the video about it.

specimen.status: Explosively common; new colonies detected in every archive with an upload button.
specimen.habitat: Preprint servers, conference submission queues, and the reference lists of other Instant Manuscripts, where it breeds by mutual citation.
specimen.field_marks: Immaculate formatting; abstract that promises everything and commits to nothing; a results section that reports significance without ever reporting an experiment; figures that are crisp, labeled, and derived from no measurable phenomenon.
specimen.call: In this work, we present a novel framework that significantly advances the state of the art across all evaluated benchmarks (see Figure 3).
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a legitimate preprint from a busy lab. Distinguish by attempting to reproduce a single cited source: the real paper points to work that exists; the Instant Manuscript points to a plausible title, plausible authors, and a plausible journal that, on inspection, has never printed a plausible thing.

spotter_tip: Pick one citation at random and try to actually find it. If the paper, the authors, and the journal all evaporate under a search, you are not reading research — you are reading its impression.
tomorrow: Manuscript surge persists into Sunday; brief clearing possible where editors reinstate a human at the front desk.

confirmed_sighting.report: The Service confirms a scholarly slop crisis in computer science, where preprint repositories and conference organizers are scrambling to counter a rising tide of AI-generated paper submissions that can be produced in under a minute.
